Having survived their encounters with both curious and dangerous local lifeforms, the crew opted to get a better view and made their way to higher ground. Atop an outcropping that afforded them a vantage above the vegetation, Elo and Beegax discovered an alien statue, standing like a sentinel and staring sternly out over the tangled landscape. Their destination still unknown and the whereabouts of Beegax’s Chadra-Fan friend still undisclosed, the fringers weigh their options in the heavy, humid air. Also, check out our custom URL and visit Modiphius - https://www.modiphius.net/respectthecrit

The crew of The Way continue their trek through the jungles of Lehon.  Having survived their encounters with both curious and dangerous local lifeforms, the crew opted to get a better view and made their way to higher ground.

Atop an outcropping that afforded them a vantage above the vegetation, Elo and Beegax discovered an alien statue, standing like a sentinel and staring sternly out over the tangled landscape.  Their destination still unknown and the whereabouts of Beegax’s Chadra-Fan friend still undisclosed, the fringers weigh their options in the heavy, humid air.

Social and scheduling - @RespectTheCrit

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 42: High Ground
item.description:
‼️IMPORTANT LINKS‼️ Red Cross Blood Donation - redcrossblood.org
It’s been a long journey for our fearless fringers as they explore an ancient and uncharted region of Wild Space. They’ve learned very quickly that even though the planet Lehon no longer hosts civilization, it is still abundant with new or perhaps very old life. After getting aquatinted with some of the local flora and fauna, Elo, Beegax and their crew, continue their search for the Chadra Fan slicer, Chai Chai, across the surface of this long forgotten world.

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 40: Liminality of Luminous Beings
item.description:
The crew of the way return from a dangerous detour codenamed the "Dollhouse," a derelict Imperial research vessel whose inhabitants stalked our fearless fringers as they tried to loot the abandoned ship. Barely escaping with their lives, they return with a haul of scavenged supplies to trade for credits and information on a safe route into the uncharted Lehon system. However, Elo also returns with a haunting souvenir, a mask belonging to one of the abhorrent experiments aboard the derelict ship, a strange reminder of some elusive element of Elo’s program, buried deep beneath their circuits and memory. The crew returns to the Ring of Kafrene to sell off their goods, get some well earned R&R, and begin their next journey into the unknown regions of Wild Space.
For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit Host & GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 39: Find Light In Darkness
item.description:
Still aboard a derelict ship, Elo and Beegax attempt to escape and reconvene with the rest of their crew aboard The Way, gone silent since it unexpectedly separated from the Imperial research vessel. But time is running out! With life support on limited supply, the fearless fringers and their associates attempt to leave out an airlock with their scavenged loot, but a terrifying new type of trooper stands in the way of their survival.

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 38: Complications
item.description:
The Crew of The Way learned they are not the only beings alive aboard the Dollhouse. They discovered the ship’s crew mangled and massacred, and a gruesome lab of human and clone experiments being done aboard the Imperial research vessel. After surviving a surprise attack by a terrifying new kind of trooper, Elo’s reality disrupting glitches compelled them to violently remove the mask from their shadowy advisory. Elo, Beegax, and their crew may not be alone in the darkness of this ship, but the promise of credits and salvage entices them further into it’s depths. For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit Host & GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

After surviving a surprise attack by a terrifying new kind of trooper, Elo’s reality disrupting glitches compelled them to violently remove the mask from their shadowy advisory.  Elo, Beegax, and their crew may not be alone in the darkness of this ship, but the promise of credits and salvage entices them further into it’s depths.

For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit

Host & GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs

Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones

Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.description:
Elo, Beegax and their crew find themselves aboard a derelict Imperial research vessel, codenamed "The Dollhouse". Looking for loot they found the violent aftermath of some secret experiment gone horribly wrong! With no survivors the abandoned ship drifted into unmarked routes through the Expanse Region of the galaxy, and yet "The Dollhouse" may not be as empty as originally thought. Now the fringers hope their scavenging will be worth the danger of whoever or whatever stalks them from the shadows. item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 36: Welcome to the Dollhouse
item.description:
In search of repairs for their ship, The Crew of the Way find themselves on the ring of Kafrene, a failed mining operation and busy trading hub occupied by the Empire. Needing to earn a few extra credits and learn a safe route through wild space, Elo and Beegax agree to take on a job, locating and looting a derelict Imperial ship rumored to be floating unprotected somewhere in the Expansion region. After probing for more information and a few more credits at a backroom sabacc game, the way crew is ready to once again jump into the unknown and potential dangers found abundantly at the Empire’s Edge.
For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit Host & GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 35: Let The Jawas Win
item.description:
‼️IMPORTANT LINKS AND TOOLS‼️ A Police Free Future - An FAQ A straight forward and informative info graph about reimagining public safety. Easy to understand and easy to send to others. Defund Police - Video (YouTube) An entertaining and concise video about dismantling, defunding and abolishing the institution of policing. Great video, easy to understand, and also easy to send to others. #8ToAbolish An easy to understand eight point plan of actionable goals to end police brutality and invest in our communities. Also easy to send. MPD150 - Resources Videos, books, articles, and media. MPD150 is a grassroots, community based project aimed at shifting the discussion about police abolitionism and providing tools and education for organizers. This is a great place to look for resources and reading. Critical Resistance A national organization focused on building a movement to abolish policing and the prison industrial complex. Another great place to look for resources and reading.
✊ SUPPORT EACH OTHER ✊ LISTEN ✊ HOPE ✊ REBEL ✊
After escaping from both an Imperial prison and a heavily guarded space port tower, the crew of The Way has made it off Socorro, sowing chaos amongst the controlling factions in and around the frontier planet. They escaped with their lives and without the consequences of bringing down the crime lords of the Outer Rim world…for now. With a full crew, and a mostly intact ship, our fearless fringers patch up their wounds, asses their options and plan for the next jump and the next adventure at the Empire’s Edge.
For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit Host & GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

They also have an app. Use Resistbot to identify and contact the offices of many of your reps. It is a text service that turns your message into a simple letter or petition. ✊ SUPPORT EACH OTHER ✊ LISTEN ✊ HOPE ✊ REBEL ✊ Captured! Beegax has been taken prisoner aboard The Severity. A large space cruiser belonging to Agent, Gerelt Tyron of the Imperial security Bureau. Separated from his crew and his slicing gear his plan to override the ship’s guns seems nigh impossible from the confines of an Imperial cell. Down on the planet, Elo has their own plans in perceivable peril. While trying to take control of Socorro’s planetary defenses, Elo and the rest of their crew drew blasters on defensive droids. Caught in a tight fire fight within the spaceport tower, the odds for success becomes smaller and smaller. But you know what they say about odds. Refrain from mentioning them in my company!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 32: Gold System Getaway Pt. 1
item.description:
The plan is in motion. Beegax, Elo, and the crew of The Way have done all they can to prepare for the ambitious take over of two sets of artillery. And with the sudden death of criminal Zalto the Hutt, they race against time in order to raise chaos amongst the factions in and around the planet Socorro, in order to escape the frontier system. Equal parts cunning, subterfuge, bravery, and luck are required to pull off their difficult scheme, balanced upon a razor thin margin for error. With the odds stacked against them, and the potential for it all to fall apart, Elo and Beegax submit themselves and their crew to two different dangerous deployments. For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit Host & GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.itunes:summary:
The plan is in motion. Beegax, Elo, and the crew of The Way have done all they can to prepare for the ambitious take over of two sets of artillery. And with the sudden death of criminal Zalto the Hutt, they race against time in order to raise chaos amongst the factions in and around the planet Socorro, in order to escape the frontier system. Equal parts cunning, subterfuge, bravery, and luck are required to pull off their difficult scheme, balanced upon a razor thin margin for error. With the odds stacked against them, and the potential for it all to fall apart, Elo and Beegax submit themselves and their crew to two different dangerous deployments. For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit Host & GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 31: Momentum
item.description:
Zalto the Hutt is dead. His grip on Socorro severed, much to the elation of the criminal Triumvirate that governs the planet. But before his corpulent corpse can cool, the fearless fringers Elo and Beegax must enact the rest of their plan to throw Socorro into chaos in order to escape the system. Their troubles far from over, Beegax and Elo scramble to keep their element of surprise as The Empire’s shadow looms in its search for the surly dug slicer and his stolen Imperial intelligence. Will the crime lord Triumvirate keep their end of a bitter bargain? Will a swift retaliation come from the Hutt home world? Will the Empire crack down on this frontier town? Freedom hangs in the balance for our star weary wanderers. For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit Host & GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 29: All In
item.description:
The cards are dealt, all bets are off, and the crew of The Way have made a plan to deal with not only their blackmail blues, but the criminal leaders on the dusty frontier of Socorro. Elo and Beegax once again head to the unfinished casino of Zalto the Hutt to enact the first step of their clever but dangerous ploy. Will they manage to play both sides and beat the House? Or Will their numbers come up 86? The stakes and the aces have never been higher, and when the chips are down the fringers may need to push their luck.

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 28: Best Laid Plans
item.description:
Once again the fringers Elo and Beegax made a climatic escape from Socorro’s walled city. Only this time they have joined with Bothan spy, Gir Tu'Tey, the elusive son of Elo’s former master. With their search for Gir finally over, Beegax and Elo can now focus on escaping Socorro alive. Extorted by the Triumvirate, in deep with Zalto the Hutt, hounded by Imperials, and still pursued by assailants, the fringers mouths have talked them into corners their feet might have trouble walking out of. The duo may be facing down more enemies than they ever have before, but for the first time they may also have more allies at their backs.

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 27: Walled City Wrangle
item.description:
Outer Rim fringers, Elo and Beegax, have once again traveled to the walled city of Cjallysce'i in hopes of finding the son of Elo’s former Bothan master. Trying to keep their movements untracked, they journeyed through underground volcanic tunnels to reach their destination in secret. But after finding their mark within a discreet safe house, the fringers were ambushed by an unknown IG assassin unit and Beegax was shot by blaster bolt. Who is hunting our hapless heroes? Will they make it out of the walled city alive once more? Will Elo be forced to choose between their duty or their alliance? Life hangs in the balance in this Socorran shootout.

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 26: Reunion
item.description:
After an exhaustive search, Elo and Beegax have finally found the son of Elo’s former master, a Bothan spy named Gir Tu'Tey, hiding out in the isolated city of Cjallysce'i. Spending time and resources to track him down has embroiled the fringers in several criminal enterprises and deals have been made with all types of unsavory citizens of Socorro. Can this reunion bring the closure Elo is looking for? What other agreements will our fringers make or break just to survive? Life and loyalty tips in the balance out here at the Emipre’s Edge. For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 25: Below the Surface
item.description:
After a harrowing battle with Socorran fauna, Beegax and Elo continue their journey to the walled city of Cjaalysce'i via a network of tunnels below the surface of the planet. However, human crew for hire, Verse, is less than thrilled about the fringers plans to help a Hutt fool the local crime lords and instigate an open conflict between Socorro and the Hutt homeworld. But will her objections endanger Elo and Beegax’s plans? Will they be forced to hide another body? Survival and obligation pull in two directions as our fringers navigate the subterranean labyrinth. For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 24: Tension in the Tunnels
item.description:
Back on Socorro, The fringers, Beegax and Elo have struck a deal with the off world gangster, Zalto the Hutt. In exchange for faking the Hutt’s death, giving him an excuse to go to war with the local Socorran crime lords, Elo and Beegax have been given access to secret, underground tunnels running form the Hutt casino under the walled city, Cjallysce'i. Once again traversing below the surface of the planet, our fringers tread cautiously into the darkest depths, in hopes of finding Elo’s elusive Bothan beneficiary. For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 23: To Kill a Hutt
item.description:
On the return trip couriering from the Imperial base on Scarif, the crew of The Way panicked after plowing into a pod of pesky purrgils, knocking their ship out of light speed. Elo believed they were on the verge of understanding their strange glitches and once again recruited Beegax’s help to slice into they’re own mind. However the delve into the droid’s depths went much deeper than they expected, pulling Beegax and Elo into a strange miasma. Pushing for answers Elo found themselves on the planet Dathomir among the mysterious Nightsisters, during a surprise attack by Separatist forces. Both fringers made it back firmly aboard their ship but with unanswered questions, unexplainable experiences, and unfinished business.
For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 22: Depths of a Droid
item.description:
CONTENT WARNING: dismemberment, loud W.A.P. in the episode tag Heading back to the planet Socorro, Elo interfaced with their ship, The Way, in an attempt to scan for pirate threats when entering the system. But Elo was unexpectedly drawn into some mysterious part of their program, and found themselves on the surface of Dathomir, a remote world shrouded in mystery. CONTENT WARNING: dismemberment, loud W.A.P. in the episode tag

Heading back to the planet Socorro, Elo interfaced with their ship, The Way, in an attempt to scan for pirate threats when entering the system. But Elo was unexpectedly drawn into some mysterious part of their program, and found themselves on the surface of Dathomir, a remote world shrouded in mystery.

Before Elo could investigate the cause of this strange glitch, the crew was ejected out of light speed after almost colliding with a pod of purrgils traveling through the Outer Rim expanse.

Elo and Beegax decided to probe further into the droid's processors, hoping to uncover the bizarre malfunctions.  But as the fringers dove into the droid's memories, Beegax was ejected from the system, and Elo pushed on seeking answers alone in the strange fog.

 

For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 20: Factions
item.description:
Against Beegax’s own advice, the fringers have taken a job for Zalto the Hutt, who has hired them to make an exchange on the Imperial outpost of Scarif. Now they are caught in the middle of a dangerous power struggle between the corpulent criminal and the machiavellian malefactors of Socorro. On which side will their loyalties fall, who is worth more to betray, and will they be able to come away unscathed or be buried among the shallow graves of those that stood against these crime lords of the Outer Rim?
For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 19: Relax, Beegax!
item.description:
Beegax and Elo have accepted a job from gregarious gangster, Zalto the Hutt. Transporting cargo and materials between the Outer Rim world of Socorro, and the Imperial occupied paradise of Scarif. In exchange they learned of a Bothan residing behind the clandestine walls of Cjaalysce'i, identified as Sno Ba’all. A possible lead in their search for the Bothan Spy Gir Tu’Tey. But Elo and Beegax are caught between sides, pressured to assassinate Zalto for the crime lords of Socorro, or to turn the tables and ally with the hubristic Hutt. All while the Empire moves in to suppress insurgent activity in the region and continue their search for stolen slicing equipment. The fearless fingers are anxious to leave the desert world as tensions and occupying forces mount around this dusty frontier. ‼️IMPORTANT LINKS AND TOOLS‼️ Bond Funds: Oregon - PDX Protest Bail Fund Portland Freedom Fund Chicago - Chicago Community Bond Fund Los Angeles: People's City Council Freedom Fund Oakland / San Jose Democratic Socialists of America Silicon Valley National organizations: NAACP ACLU Visit Black Lives Matter to donate and find the nearest chapter in your area. item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 18: High Rise Hutt
item.description:
While avoiding the Empire presence on Socorro, Elo and Beegax took the opportunity to re-equip and rearm themselves, and came away with a rare Jedi weapon from a less than reputable source. After recouping their losses, the fringers make their way to the extravagant casino at the edge of the city, its construction rising to rival the towers of Soco-Jaal spaceport. It is there they are to meet Zalto the Hutt, a notorious gangster and target of an assassination plot engineered by the crime lords of Socorro. Elo and Beegax must weigh their option carefully, which side of this rivalry will they fall on, what are they willing to risk, and how will they escape the system alive?
For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 17: Occupation and Recuperation
item.description:
IT'S A SHOPPING EPISODE! The Empire is on Socorro! Imperial forces arrive after a clash with Saw Gerrera's Partisans on the Outer Rim frontier. Looking to put down any rebellious uprising, storm troopers patrol the cities, continuing their search for sensitive stolen data. Meanwhile, Elo and Beegax lay low to heal their wounds after being abducted by the Partisan vigilantes. Beegax’s custom slicing equipment was destroyed whil e trying to save the droid Elo. But sometimes to put something together, we must take it apart. The fringers are finding courage isn’t always the absence of fear, but standing up when you’re most afraid. For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 16: Shattered
item.description:
The renegade slicer, Beegax Botano, and the modified medical droid, Elo, attempted a high speed escape from Imperial troopers, targeting Beegax’s specialized slicing computer. With Elo’s glitches getting worse, and their contacts unable to help them, the fearless fingers took a risky gambit and engaged their attackers head on. With the assist of some mysterious yet timely strangers, the fringers brought down the stormtrooper shuttle. But just when they thought they’d escape danger, Beegax and Elo were abducted by the unknown vigilantes and taken without explanation to a location unknown.
For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 15: Into the Fire
item.description:
!!IMPORTANT LINKS AND TOOLS!!! Use FiveCalls.Org to identify your state and federal reps AND use their scripts to make phone calls to the offices of your representatives. They also have an app. Use Resistbot to identify and contact the offices of many of your reps. It is a text service that turns your message into a simple letter or petition. Bond funds to support jailed protesters: National fund - LGBTQ Fund These are for Minnesota and California. You can also look for one in your area: Minnesota Freedom Fund Los Angeles: People's City Council Freedom Fund Oakland / San Jose Democratic Socialists of America Silicon Valley National organizations: NAACP ACLU Visit Black Lives Matter to donate and find the nearest chapter in your area. ✊ SUPPORT EACH OTHER ✊ LISTEN ✊ HOPE ✊ REBEL ✊ Returned to the planet Socorro, and safely landed in the walled city of Cjaalysce'i, Elo and Beegax part ways with their new comrades. But before they could enjoy the sites of the secluded city, they were contacted by the triumvirate, a trio of crime lords who control Socorro, and extorted into carrying out an assassination on the untouchable Zalto the Hutt. With little choice and fewer options, the fearless fingers agreed, hoping to turn their disadvantage into opportunity. Elo further investigated the strange glitches in their programming, but came away with more questions than answers. Meanwhile Beegax discovered his stolen slicing system is treacherously traceable, when he and Elo were attacked by Imperial viper droids sweeping the city. The fringers escape by speeder across the Badlands only to be pursued by a powerful predator, The Empire.

Returned to the planet Socorro, and safely landed in the walled city of Cjaalysce'i, Elo and Beegax part ways with their new comrades.  But before they could enjoy the sites of the secluded city, they were contacted by the triumvirate, a trio of crime lords who control Socorro, and extorted into carrying out an assassination on the untouchable Zalto the Hutt.

With little choice and fewer options, the fearless fingers agreed, hoping to turn their disadvantage into opportunity.  Elo further investigated the strange glitches in their programming, but came away with more questions than answers.  Meanwhile Beegax discovered his stolen slicing system is treacherously traceable, when he and Elo were attacked by Imperial viper droids sweeping the city.  The fringers escape by speeder across the Badlands only to be pursued by a powerful predator, The Empire.

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 14: Sortie on Socorro
item.description:
Beegax & Ello, along with their new allies, Verse & Kreed, planned a risky mission to rescue Verse's comrade, hiding out on an Imperial outpost in an occupied, war torn system. While infiltrating the Empire’s marshaling station near the planet Geoniss, the crew made contact with Verse’s desperate friend, a pregnant Culisetto anxious to get her children smuggled to safety. With Beegax’s swift slicing & Ello’s medical expertise the crew were able to implant the young Culisetto eggs in Beegax’s own body & transport them safely to the frontier planet of Tatooine. Now having made good on their bargain with Verse, the enterprising adventurers hope to enlist the helpful human and gregarious gran as full fledged members of the crew of The Way.
For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.ns2:encoded:
Beegax & Ello, along with their new allies, Verse & Kreed, planned a risky mission to rescue Verse's comrade, hiding out on an Imperial outpost in an occupied, war torn system.  While infiltrating the Empire’s marshaling station near the planet Geoniss, the crew made contact with Verse’s desperate friend, a pregnant Culisetto anxious to get her children smuggled to safety.

With Beegax’s swift slicing & Ello’s medical expertise the crew were able to implant the young Culisetto eggs in Beegax’s own body & transport them safely to the frontier planet of Tatooine.  Now having made good on their bargain with Verse, the enterprising adventurers hope to enlist the helpful human and gregarious gran as full fledged members of the crew of The Way.

 

For more info and scheduling follow @RespectTheCrit

item.description:

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 12: Journey to Geonosis Pt. 1
item.description:
Dragging themselves out of the Socorran Badlands, Beegax, Elo and Verse returned to their ship, only to find the fractured freighter grounded with gravity locks. More complications arose when they discover the body of the Black Sun bounty hunter was also missing, stolen by the crime lords of Socorro, who hope to extort the fringers into assassinating a Hutt rival. While the intrepid crew try to negotiate for favor in Socorro’s criminal underworld, the clock ticks down on Verse’s rescue mission to the war zone of Geonosis. Tensions run high, with questions unanswered, and danger begins to surround Elo and Beegax, leaving little room to escape.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 11: Buried in the Badlands
item.description:
After stealing from a group of Nikto gangsters Elo, Beegax and Verse fled into the night, only to be chased across the sands. Their plans of escape where further flurried by one of Socorro’s harrowing hazards, a deadly sandstorm! Outgunned and soon to be overrun, Beegax steered directly into the wind and sand, in an attempt to lose their pursuers, only to have the gangster’s starship join the chase. A rebooted but severally injured Elo rushed to assist in their evasion, but Socorro’s storm devoured all and our fleeing fringers were sucked down through the swift sands into the darkness below.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 10: Black Winds
item.description:
Deep in the Socorran Badlands, Elo, Beegax, and their new partner in crime, Verse, successfully steal several crates of contraband, and race back to civilization. They are pursued by a group of Nikto gangsters, looking to reclaim their purloined property. Overrun and outgunned, Elo was critically injured in the escape, just as a terrifying sand storm began to make its way across the planet’s surface.

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 09: The Placebo Job
item.description:
After a tense meeting with the human Socorron, Vers, Elo and Beegax agree to help her rescue a friend from the nearby system of Geonosis. In exchange, their new ally agrees to assist them with a dubious deed for the Rodian, Placeebo, whose connections to Socorro’s underworld offers the promise of credits and commission. However these opportunities come with strings, tied to the fat fingers of a fearsome Hutt gangster, Zalto. But can Beegax and Elo afford to pass up the chance to impress the influential? The aforementioned appointment far on the outskirts of the city, could be more than the fringers bargained for, and Elo and Beegax may learn the full price of a favor on the black sands of Socorro.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

After a tense meeting with the human Socorron, Vers, Elo and Beegax agree to help her rescue a friend from the nearby system of Geonosis. In exchange, their new ally agrees to assist them with a dubious deed for the Rodian, Placeebo, whose connections to Socorro’s underworld offers the promise of credits and commission. However these opportunities come with strings, tied to the fat fingers of a fearsome Hutt gangster, Zalto. But can Beegax and Elo afford to pass up the chance to impress the influential? The aforementioned appointment far on the outskirts of the city, could be more than the fringers bargained for, and Elo and Beegax may learn the full price of a favor on the black sands of Socorro.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 08: Dust and Debt
item.description:
Elo and Beegax land on the planet Socorro, an Outer Rim world far from the concerns or control of the ever expanding Empire. Only hours after arriving and already in debt, the fearless fringers look for a means to make repairs to their badly damaged ship. Venturing out from the spaceport into the planet’s capital city, Vakeyya, Beegax and Elo make their way to the Umbra Vale tavern, following up on a furtive lead and hoping to learn more about the Bothan agent, Gir Tu’Tey hiding somewhere on the scorched surface of Socorro.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 07: Warm Welcome
item.description:
Elo and Beegax limp into Socorro after narrowly escaping a pirate attack within the asteroid belt surrounding the planet. The crew of the Crooked Horn, led by captain D’Vreq Nemenox left the intrepid spacer’s ship broken and damaged, but ultimately un-plundered. With their spirits tested, their bodies pushed to their limits and their ship in bad need of repair, Elo and Beegax brave a new and possibly dangerous world, hoping for a warmer welcome upon the black sands of this Outer Rim frontier.

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 06: Ambush in the Asteroids
item.description:
Leaving Bothawui behind, Beegax and Elo have finally arrived at their destination, the remote world of Socorro in the Outer Rim. A system at the edge of the empire and the boundaries of uncharted, wild space. The intrepid fringers plot their next move now that the seemingly unstoppable bounty hunter is finally defeated…or is he? Just kidding, he’s definitely dead! Approaching the system’s perilous asteroid belt, Beegax and Elo consider the treacherous astral terrain between them and the planet Socorro.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 05: Loose Ends at Lightspeed
item.description:
After discovering the possible last known location of Gir Tu’Tey, newly allied Elo and Beegax Botano are anxious to leave Bothawui for the Socorro system. But before they could set out, the two tangled with a tough and treacherous Trandoshan. Their gallant gambles to overcome the relentless bounty hunter paid off in tenuous victory, but left brave Beegax benumbed and the disparate droid in disrepair. Have they finally put down their persistent pursuer? Can they make it to the Outer Rim before their pasts catch up to them? Nothing is certain at the edges of the empire and answers are as elusive as missing memories.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 04: Storm on The Way
item.description:
Returning to Bothawui, the droid Elo and renegade slicer Beegax Botano smuggled their way onto a doonium ore facility down on the planet. Disguising themselves as common transporters, they attempted to access a Bothan Spy Net intelligence drop, hidden in plain sight. After creating a convincing distraction, Beegax had seconds to slice his way into the network and uncover the whereabouts of Gir Tu’Tey, a young Bothan spy and son of Elo’s former master. Successfully disrupting the Bothan Spy Net security, Beegax uncovered Gir’s last know location somewhere in the Socorro system, far out in the lawless reaches of the Outer Rim. With local hyper lane traffic being closely monitored and time in short supply, Elo and Beegax must try and escape Bothawui undiscovered and undetected.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera
Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 03: Bound to Bothawui
item.description:
Floating above the Bothan homeworld, the droid Elo and the renegade slicer, Beegax Botano, recuperate from their skirmish down on the planet. Both are anxious to leave Bothan space after escaping a terrifying Trandoshan bounty hunter set on capturing Beegax and his customized slicing deck. However, Elo must learn the secret location of Gir Tu’Tey, to fulfill a final request given to them by their deceased Bothan master. With threats looming and freedom so close at hand the unlikely pair weigh their options aboard Elo’s ship, The Way, during this tentative moment of calm...

Both are anxious to leave Bothan space after escaping a terrifying Trandoshan bounty hunter set on capturing Beegax and his customized slicing deck. However, Elo must learn the secret location of Gir Tu’Tey, to fulfill a final request given to them by their deceased Bothan master. With threats looming and freedom so close at hand the unlikely pair weigh their options aboard Elo’s ship, The Way, during this tentative moment of calm...
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 02: Can You Dug It?
item.description:
It is a time of celebration on Bothawui. Fugitive slicer, Beegax Botano, avoids the crowds and consequences of the bounty on his head, but a sinister assailant stalks him from the shadows. Meanwhile, the masterless droid, Elo makes their way through the city throng, hoping to make contact with the renegade slicer. They are charged to find their late master’s son, Gir Tu’Tey, whose location is concealed by the Bothan Spy Network.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera

item.title: Empire's Edge - Ep. 01: Empire's Edge
item.description:
It is a period of uncertainty and fear. The Clone Wars are over, the Jedi are destroyed, and the newly formed GALACTIC EMPIRE controls the galaxy through oppression and tyranny. In this dark era, the lone droid LO-RNA returns with their recently deceased master to the planet Bothawui, home world of the Bothan species and their infamous espionage network. Bound by a sombre duty to their late owner, the droid Elo is compelled to take on one final task.
For more info and scheduling @RespectTheCrit GM - Ian Duncan @iduncs Elo - Jamie Lee-Bonés @jamielee.bones Beegax Botano - Alex Herrera @aeherrera Whatever the system, whether it's a miss or a hit, you always gotta respect the crit!
